title: 2020 extrusion L corner plate
prompt: Flat L-shaped corner plate to join two 2020 aluminium extrusions at 90°. Each leg is 60 mm long and 20 mm wide (the corner square is shared), 4 mm thick. Five M5 clearance holes (5.5 mm) on the extrusion centrelines, 20 mm apart: one in the corner square and two along each leg.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
60 x 60 mm L, 4 mm thick, ±0.1 mm
Five M5 clearance holes (5.3–5.6 mm) in an L at 20 mm pitch
L outline: six flat side faces plus top and bottom

notes: 2020 slot centreline is 10 mm from the profile edge; M5 T-nuts.
